description: Source code for recovery UI handling on a Samsung device, including key input processing, device start-up, and reboot logic.

methods.name: device_recovery_start
methods.description: Initializes recovery process, waits for userdata partition to be available.

methods.name: device_toggle_display
methods.description: Determines whether to toggle display based on power and volume-up keys.

methods.name: device_reboot_now
methods.description: Reboots device after power key is pressed five times.

methods.name: device_handle_key
methods.description: Handles key input events and returns corresponding actions.
